subject.title: fix(doctor): backport plugin compatibility repair to 2026.7.2

question: Should the 2026.7.2 release branch include the already-merged Doctor upgrade repair for legacy channel configuration installed during repair?
rationale: The patch is technically aligned with current main, but release-branch inclusion and its upgrade-validation threshold are release-owner decisions.

options.title: Include the backport
options.body: Merge this narrow parity backport after the release-branch update-and-restart scenario confirms the legacy Discord configuration is repaired.

options.title: Defer to a later release
options.body: Leave 2026.7.2 unchanged and carry the main-branch repair in a later release if the release window cannot support the upgrade validation.

recommendation.title: Include the backport
recommendation.body: Merge this narrow parity backport after the release-branch update-and-restart scenario confirms the legacy Discord configuration is repaired.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged main repair and authored the release-branch backport.
